ValidationRule.description: If “Account Source” = 'Referral - Agency', "Channel Type" = 'Agent' or 'Sub-Agent', then both Referral Primary and Referral Secondary must be completed
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISPICKVAL(AccountSource, "Referral - Agency"), INCLUDES(Alliance_Type__c , "Agent"), INCLUDES(Alliance_Type__c, "Sub-Agent") ), OR( ISBLANK(Referral_Detail__c), ISBLANK(Referral_Secondary__c) ) ) && NOT($Permission.BypassValidationRules) && NOT( $User.Id = '0053b00000CSZR6')
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please populate 'Referral Primary' and 'Referral Secondary' when Account Source = 'Referral - Agency' or when Channel Type = 'Agent' or 'Sub-Agent'
